faq_a1: The basic income and statistics dashboard is free. Paid features will appear later
faq_q2: How do I connect the services I work in?
faq_a2: You enter the phone or the service login and password once, and confirm the sign in with a code if needed. The data is encrypted and goes straight to the service, we do not get a copy of the login and password. Raznos only pulls history and income and does not manage the account. Disconnect a service and the related data is removed
faq_q3: Does Raznos store my service passwords?
faq_a3: No. Passwords and access keys are stored only on your phone, we do not keep them on the server
faq_a4: Only you see your own data, client data is anonymized, we work under 152-FZ
faq_q5: Can I accept orders right in the app?
faq_a5: Not yet. You accept an order in the service app, and Raznos helps open it in one tap and keeps your income, history and schedule. Accepting orders inside Raznos is planned for later
final_h2: All services and all income on one screen
final_proof: 11 services · 1105 cities · real numbers from connected accounts
final_dek: Open the live prototype and walk through the courier scenarios
faq_q6: Is Raznos an employer, who pays?
faq_a6: No. Raznos does not pay for orders and does not hand them out. The delivery service itself pays and hires. We connect to your services, show orders and statistics and count income. The money comes from the service

faq_a7: There are no direct analogs in Russia. Abroad there are partial analogs, aggregator apps for
faq_q8: How do I sign in to the services I work with?
faq_a8: You enter the service phone or login and password once, and confirm the sign in with a code if needed. The data is encrypted and goes straight to the service, we do not get a copy of the login and password. Read only access: Raznos pulls history and income but does not manage the account. Disconnect a service and the related data is removed
faq_q9: What do you do with my data?
faq_a9: Only you see your personal dashboard with income and history. We work under 152-FZ: we hide buyers' names and contacts, exact addresses and phones do not get into history. Shared statistics get data without names and only when there is enough of it. Disconnect a service or delete your account and the related data is removed
faq_q10: Is there a demo mode, can I try it?
faq_a10: Yes. You can open the live prototype and walk through the courier scenarios, or connect your own account and see your own numbers
